rubrics.prompt: Make a 10-song playlist inspired by Daft Punk.
criteria: meaningful relation to Daft Punk via French/electronic house, disco/funk production or documented stylistic similarity
interpretationNotes: Not every track needs to be house; direct Daft Punk recordings are eligible but cannot alone supply discovery variety.
sharedChecks: ten requested slots reported independently from fit
rubrics.grading: good=credible recording or clearly scoped release evidence supports fit; partial=related but central requirements or exact version unverified; mismatch=credible evidence conflicts with request; unknown=insufficient or ambiguous evidence. AI web assessment, not a listening judgment.
